faq.q: Which neighbourhood plans does the 2050 OCP actually contain?
faq.a: Seven, all in Schedule B: B1 Agricultural Area, B2 Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island, B3 Downtown, B4 Eastern Hillsides, B5 Sardis, B6 South Vedder and B7 Yarrow. Schedule C is the Mountain View Heritage Conservation Area and Schedule D is the Development Permit Areas schedule — so the live page's "Sardis (Schedule D)" and "Eastern Hillsides (Schedule C)" labels do not match the current OCP.

faq.q: How does BC's SSMUH legislation apply in Chilliwack?
faq.a: Through Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2024, No. 5395, adopted June 18, 2024, amending Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000; within that frame a secondary suite is capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the principal dwelling, only 1 accessory dwelling unit is permitted per lot, and garden suites are capped at 100 m² (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: How do I check the OCP designation and zoning on a specific Chilliwack address?
faq.a: On the City of Chilliwack Webmap — the City's own OCP page points readers to the Webmap alongside the OCP Maps — checking the parcel's zoning, OCP land use designation, Schedule D permit areas and floodplain layers; per-parcel results are not stated in this file.
